snapshot_implementation.scope: Only tracked and untracked paths under gift/ plus gift/-scoped Git status. The manifests hash each path, mode and file content SHA-256.
snapshot_implementation.unchanged_check: run.py compares tracked_and_untracked_sha256 at its before and after snapshots; it does not compare the status digest.

expected_candidate_delta.lifecycle: evaluate.py checks baseline core targets clean relative to HEAD, checks and applies the selected patch before starting run.py, then reverses it after the native runner group stops. The driver record reports selected_patch_restored=true.
expected_candidate_delta.snapshot_timing: run.py takes both gift/ source snapshots while the candidate patch is active; source_final.json is written before evaluate.py reverses the patch.
expected_candidate_delta.interpretation: The candidate aggregate digest is expected to differ because the selected patch changes a tracked gift/ file. Task documentation is outside source_snapshot scope and cannot explain or contribute to this digest difference.

verification_boundary.established: Both arms have stable gift/ manifests from before to after their respective native runs; same HEAD, same file counts and same untracked manifest. The candidate treatment patch is recorded, targets only loss.py, and was restored after its run. The shared implementation pin hashes also match at receipt extraction.
verification_boundary.not_established: The receipts store aggregate manifests rather than per-file manifests, so the exact sole-file delta between the two arm snapshots cannot be proven from these digests alone. The available per-file pin covers shared implementation files but not components/loss.py; the saved patch and evaluator preflight establish the intended loss.py variant, not a complete cross-arm per-file inventory.
verification_boundary.digest_reconstruction_attempt: A read-only in-memory reconstruction was attempted but did not return a manifest result in its tool call; no second pass was started under the no-repeat constraint. Exact cross-arm localization therefore remains unavailable from this attempt.
